It changes delivery cost, not the missing predictive signal; no savings are inherited here.
alternatives.status: separate retained lineage, not selected for this mutation

choice: independent bounded synthetic development alongside the frozen 10MB scale gate
mathematical_scope: Bounded integer remainder, exact telescoping weighted-error identity, Q16 input allowance, fixed-sequence/fixed-weight bounds and an explicit counterexample to universal prediction improvement.
next_action: Implement one native P/K/D/S realization with frozen Q16 remainder, all three value layers and per-model resets; establish source and codec parity before a separately admitted 250KB gate. Do not change the live10MB experiment.
novelty: Error feedback is established mathematics. No novelty or Hutter compression claim is made for the principle.

proposed_state_boundary.D_S: Each arm must synchronize its own encoder/decoder states. Changed neural, cache and mixer trajectories relative to P are intentional; existing learning code and update schedule are unchanged, not their resulting parameter values.
proposed_state_boundary.P_K: All authoritative parent probabilities and states must match. K may retain discarded quantizer bookkeeping.

selection_reason: Carry previously discarded value-rounding information in a bounded causal state, rather than claiming the existing float cache restores precision. The error-feedback identity makes the local approximation falsifiable; predictive gain still requires native archives.
